# VGAN — Premium dairy-free chocolate

> VGAN makes premium, organic, dairy-free (vegan) chocolate: six plant-based bars crafted taste-first. Vegan, USDA Organic, gluten-free and non-GMO. Born in Norway, sold across the United States. Brand platform: "Joyful Rebellion".

## About
- Company: VGAN Inc., 205 East 42nd Street, Suite 1900, New York, NY 10017, USA. Contact: contact@eatvgan.com
- Positioning: premium chocolate that happens to be dairy-free — taste leads; vegan/organic are a bonus, not the pitch.
- Certifications: USDA Organic, Vegan, Certified B Corporation, Gluten-Free, Non-GMO, Dairy-Free.
- Cocoa: certified-organic and traceable, from Sierra Leone and the DR Congo via partner Tradin Organic.
- Carbon footprint: about 1.2 kg CO2e per kilo (measured by CarbonCloud), working toward below 1.
- Languages: English (default), Norsk (?lang=no), Español (?lang=es).

## Products (six bars)
- Creamy Melt — 44% cocoa — smooth milk-style with roasted almond.
- Pink Love — 35% cocoa — white cocoa butter with raspberry and almond.
- Salty Almonds — 44% cocoa — roasted almonds and sea salt.
- Salty Caramel — 33% cocoa — buttery caramel, sea salt and toasted almond.
- Dark — 70% cocoa — deep and intense.
- Coffee Beans — 44% cocoa — crunchy roasted coffee.

## Where to buy
- US natural and grocery retailers including Sprouts and Hy-Vee; online via Amazon and Instacart.
- Store finder: https://lovevgan.com/where-to-buy.php
